title: Share installed model catalog lookup and local storage
goal: Vision: V-2. Keep each curated catalog available in standalone core while sharing verified pack loading, ordered lookup and host override reads with unchanged model selection and credentials.

reuse.searched: Existing crate catalog utilities, core verified extension pack loader and atomic override storage, four public lookup managers and their downstream CLI/MCP consumers. Commercial Ecosystem Hub bundled catalog and fingerprint admission do not own the local preferences, overlay order or credential lookup.
